buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses QUALIFICATION OF TENDERERS & DEFINITION OF SIMILAR WORK (PQC) Evaluation will be done based on the documents submitted by the tenderers. No correspondence s hall be made after opening of technical part regarding any missing document. Only such firms need tender who can produce satisfactory evidence that they have the necessary experience & financial resources and organization to undertake such work as per criteria mention ed below. (i) The Tenderer’s average annual turnover for the work during last 03 years, ending 31st March of the previous financial year, should be at least 30% of estimated value i.e Rs. 11.7 0 Lakhs in Audited balance sheet & profit & loss account of each year must be submitted by t

he tenderer. (ii) Experience of having successfully completed Deployment of Labour in Mines /Mill during l ast 07 years ending last day of month previous to the one in which application are invited sho uld be either of the following: a) One single similar completed job costing not less than 80% of estimated value i.e Rs. 31.20 Lakhs. or b) Two similar completed jobs costing not less than 50% of estimated value each i.e Rs. 19.50 Lakhs. or c) Three similar completed jobs costing not less than 40% of estimated value each i.e Rs. 15.60 Lakhs. SIMILAR WORK: Similar work means Deployment of Labour in Mines / Mill . The contractor will have to submit c opy of the work order as well as the completion certificate from the concern department in suppor t of their experience/ credential. GEOGRAPHICAL PRESENCE: Office registration certificate (registered office or at least one of the registered branch office of the bidder shall be located and registered within the geographical limits of Jharkhand state where th e services needs to be provided). Documentary evidence must be provided in the form of Municipality trade licence or other such do cuments as per the following which satisfies as a proof of having the office establishment. a) Trade Licence issued by the local authority in the name of the firm or b) Landline phone number in the name of the firm. c) Electricity bill for the last one year in the name of the Firm or d) GSTIN registration or e) Udyam /MSME/Udyog Aadhar certificate. f) Office rent agreement is not acceptable/ not valid. In case of any ambiguity, Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC of GEM will supersede the GEM GTC.

SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT SCOPE OF WORK: Deployment of labour for miscellaneous work for Banduhurang Opencast Min e. Basically the work includes Supply/Operation of drinking water, Operation of Wheel Washing Sy stem and helpers for Survey and Geology works and other miscellaneous works inside or outside t he Banduhurang unit/area, depending upon the requirement and as instructed by the Engineer-in- charge. WORK COMPLETION PERIOD: The time of completion period of this work will be 01 (On e) year. WORKING HOURS: The work shall normally be carried out in A, B and C shift (including Sunday). On requirement basis work can also be done on holidays as per direction of Engineer- in-charge. 4. SECURITY DEPOSIT: The security deposit for this tender with earnest money will be 10% of the value of the contract. 5% shall be submitted in form of BG from Nationalized bank / Scheduled Commercial bank and 5% shall be submitted from Monthly R.A bills. 5. TAX & DUTIES: The quoted rate should be inclusive of taxes & including GST. Hence, no oth er taxes and duties would be paid extra on any imposition of new Governmental taxes / duties dur ing the contract execution period. 6. INSURANCE : Necessary workmen insurance covered for 15 (Fifteen) workmen shall be obta ined by the contractor for the workmen engaged at site for this work at their own cost for the wh ole period of the contract and shall be furnished to the corporation before commencement of the work without which contractor will not be allowed to start the work. 7. The Contractor should follow minimum wages of labours as per latest notification of A.L.C (C) , Chaibasa. In case of any increase in minimum wages, the same has to be paid by the Contractor. 8. PENALTY: The average monthly deployment of labour shall not be less than 12 nos. If aver age monthly attendance of labour is not maintained than penalty will be deducted from mo nthly R.A bill at the rate which is as follows:- a) No penalty will be deducted for 12 average daily deployments are maintained. b) If average daily attendance less than 12 man days @ Rs. 500/- penalty will be deducte d for each short fall attendance from monthly RA bill. 9. In case of stoppage of work by local people/bandh or any other reasons no idle charges wi ll be paid by corporation towards Labour, plant and Machinery etc. to the contractor for this work. 10. In case payment of laborers engaged for this work, has not been made on stipulated pay ment day, Corporation shall compel the contractor to stop the work besides taking other su itable steps to make the payment to the workers at risk and cost of the Contractor. 11. SAFETY & PPE: Contractor and all workmen should follow SOP (Safe Operating Procedur e) and all statutory guidelines issued by regulatory bodies time to time. All PPE (Personal P rotective Equipments) required to execute this work will be given free of cost by UCIL.

12. Quantity of any individual item may vary to any extent and be excluded altogether. Contr actor will carry out all works up to a total variation of +10% (Ten) on the contract price and all quoted rates shall remain firm within this limit. 13. SECURITY RULES: Contractor shall strictly abide by the security rules and regulations en forced by the owner time to time. You have to provide proper identity cards, badges etc to his employees wherever directed by the Engineer. 14. PRICE ESCALATION: Labour escalation will be paid 100% as per actual basis for all categories, latest notified by Government or by UCIL. Labour escalation will be as per GEM: In case of any change in minimum wages / statu tory wage components as per application laws during the contract period is payable by the buyer to the service provider. The difference amount in wages without having in any impac t on service charges shall be remain same as per the original contract value. 15. Monthly R.A bills and Final bill will be made for this work. EPF & paid holidays shall be pai d by the contractor as per norms. Bonus shall be paid by the contractor as per norms & PF i s applicable as per the norms of UCIL. 16. DEFECT LIABILITY PERIOD: Nil. 17. CERTIFICATE: You have to give a certificate of liability for damage done by your employ ees /workmen. You have to provide details address of the employees/workmen also. 18. The corporation may for any reason, asks the contractor to suspend the work, fully or part ly and the contractor shall comply with same without having any claim whatsoever for such suspension. 19. Time and quantity (10%) extension may be taken on urgency with prior approval of comp etent authority. During time and quantity extension party has to carry over work with same rate, terms and condition of the contract. 20. CONTRACT LABOUR ACT: All the labour rules shall be followed strictly as per Contract l abour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970 – All register, form stipulated under minimum wag es (Central rules) Act 1950 should be maintained by the contractor and to be furnished to t he corporation before commencement of the work. In the event of the breach of aforesaid conditions the contractor shall be open for action as deemed fit by the concerned labour au thorities of the Central Government. Contractor shall have to provide the facilities under th e provision of contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970-Section – 16, 17, 18 and 1 9, Chapter – V- “Welfare and Health of Contract Labour”. 21. Geographical Presence: Bidder should have registered office / branch in Jharkhand st ate.

22. In case of any ambiguity, Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC of GEM will supersede th e GEM GTC. 23. The eligibility be decided strictly based on documents submitted at the time of receipt of tenders. No additional documents be allowed to be submitted after receipt of tenders but there is no bar to seek clarification or authentication of submitted documents. However in case of poor response, wi th a view to increase the competition, admission of additional documents to meet the PQ criteria may be allowed subject to the condition that a. “Poor Response” implies when less than three bids are found suitable on the basis of s ubmitted eligible documents as per NIT. b. The additional documents should not be issued subsequent to last date of receipt of tender as mentioned in the NIT. c. The bidder submitting additional documents has submitted EMD and tender cost as pre scribed in NIT. The opportunity of submission of additional documents be given to all the bidders. 24. Earned Leave: a. Contractor has to comply, leave with wages as per new OSHWC code 2020 sec tion 32. Every worker employed in a mine shall be entitled for leave in a calendar year with wages subject to the following conditions:- i) that he has worked one hundred and eighty (180) days or more in such cale ndar year; ii) that he shall be entitled for one (1) day leave for every twenty (20) days of his work, in such calendar year; b. The request for leave may be adjusted against Earned leave accumulated, if any. c. The contractor shall be Re-imbursed the amount based on the bill raised after payment of the earned Leave of their work persons based on certification by the concerned Engi neer-in-charge and duly vetted by the concerned personnel manager on pro-rata basis. d. The final bill shall be cleared after compliance with the Earned Leave provisions. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
